query: DO $$ DECLARE v_template_id UUID; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_template_id FROM public.inspection_templates WHERE code = 'government-hospital-accreditation'; IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.inspection_templates SET facility_profile_fields = '[{"key": "reference_quarter", "type": "select", "label": "Reference Quarter", "required": true, "options": ["Q1 (Jan-Mar)", "Q2 (Apr-Jun)", "Q3 (Jul-Sep)", "Q4 (Oct-Dec)"], "sort_order": 1},{"key": "reference_year", "type": "number", "label": "Reference Year", "required": true, "sort_order": 2},{"key": "facility_name", "type": "text", "label": "Name of Facility", "required": true, "sort_order": 3},{"key": "address", "type": "text", "label": "Address of Facility / Location", "required": true, "sort_order": 4},{"key": "lga_district", "type": "text", "label": "Local Government / Senatorial District", "required": true, "sort_order": 5},{"key": "facility_email", "type": "email", "label": "Facility Email", "required": true, "sort_order": 6},{"key": "nhia_accredited", "type": "boolean", "label": "Is your facility accredited by NHIA?", "required": true, "pair_with": "nhia_reg_no", "sort_order": 7},{"key": "nhia_reg_no", "type": "text", "label": "Registration Number", "required": false, "sort_order": 8},{"key": "oranghis_enrollees", "type": "number", "label": "Number of ORANGHIS enrollees accessing care — (Select Quarter Above)", "required": true, "sort_order": 9},{"key": "last_hfmc_meeting", "type": "text", "label": "When last did the Health Facility Management Committee meet? (Check for minutes/attendance)", "required": true, "sort_order": 10},{"key": "dedicated_officer", "type": "boolean", "label": "Is there a dedicated officer for ORANGHIS?", "required": true, "sort_order": 11},{"key": "desk_officer_name", "type": "text", "label": "Name of Desk Officer", "required": true, "sort_order": 12},{"key": "desk_officer_phone", "type": "text", "label": "Phone Number of Desk Officer", "required": true, "sort_order": 13},{"key": "tpa_visits", "type": "boolean", "label": "Did you receive monthly supervisory visits from the TPA? (Ask for supervisory visit report or score)", "required": true, "sort_order": 14},{"key": "odchc_visits", "type": "boolean", "label": "Did you receive quarterly supervisory visits from the ODCHC? (Check for report of last visit)", "required": true, "sort_order": 15},{"key": "service_24h", "type": "boolean", "label": "Does your facility provide 24-hour service? (Check facility roster/shift)", "required": true, "sort_order": 16}]'::jsonb WHERE id = v_template_id; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Total number of staff (skilled and non-skilled) in your health facility' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q14'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Have you received training on ORANGHIS implementation? (Ask for certificate/evidence of training)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q16'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'How much did you generate apart from ORANGHIS fund · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q19'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Number of referrals for secondary services by your facility · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q21a'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Number of referrals to SHF approved for your facility · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q21b'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Did you refer ORANGHIS beneficiaries to SHC facility? · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q21c'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Did you refer ORANGHIS beneficiaries to other facilities? · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q22a'; UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET item_label = 'Evidence of capitation received (Table) · Quarter: (select quarter in Section A)' WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND item_code = 'Q24c'; END IF; END $$;
